title: Creepers and Tridents
description: This Datapack reworks the Impaling and Channeling enchantments and allows Creeper spawn eggs of various tiers to be crafted in survival!
body:
This Datapack Reworks Impaling and Channeling as well as adding craftable creeper eggs

For now this Datapack on works on 26.2 snapshots 3+ (sad) but I plan to keep updating it with each new version that releases, I however have no plans to work on backward compatibility but if anyone wants to modify this or take inspiration from it for earlier versions feel free to

Impaling:
 
 Old:
  - Deal 2.5 extra damage per level to aquatic mobs
 
 New:
  - Deal 3.25 extra damage per level to aquatic mobs and drowned 
  - Deal 0.5 + 0.25 * level extra damage on melee attack
  - Deal 2 + 1 * level extra damage on thrown attack
  - Mutually exclusive with Channeling


Channeling:
 
Old: thrown attacks that land on mobs or lightning rods with sky access during thunderstorms cause a channeled lightning

 New:
  - Level 1: Identical to default Channeling
  - Level 2: Now also works during Rain allowing for more frequent uses
  - Level 3: Works regardless of weather
  - Level 4: No longer requires sky access
  - Mutually exclusive with Channeling


Creeper Eggs:

 Manually ignited Creepers: Egg + Gunpowder * 4

 Auto Ignited Creepers:
  - 40 ticks fuse: creeper egg + fire charge + gunpowder
  - 35 ticks fuse: creeper egg + fire charge + gunpowder * 2
  - 30 ticks fuse: creeper egg + fire charge + gunpowder * 3
  - 25 ticks fuse: creeper egg + fire charge + gunpowder * 4
  - 20 ticks fuse: creeper egg + fire charge + gunpowder * 5
